title: In the Notion database, each entry will have the following properties: 🤔
Each column in the database serves a different purpose;
type
b
: Indicates the type of data, which can be notice (公告), post (文章), page (单页), menu (菜单), submenu (子菜单), among others.
slug
b

: Depending on the data type, it serves different functions: in menus, it indicates the page to which it links; in articles, it represents the access address of the article within the blog. For instance, if the data is a page with the slug "test", it can be accessed via https://domain/test; whereas if it's a post with the slug "example", it can be accessed via https://domain/article/example, and it will also appear in your homepage list.
